    · rcases PFun.mem_fix_iff.1 h with (h | ⟨_, h, _⟩) <;> rw [e] at h <;>

  · refine ReflTransGen.head_induction_on h₁ ?_ fun h _ IH ↦ ?_
    · refine PFun.mem_fix_iff.2 (Or.inl ?_)
